Grid simCount4 permits home+3 owned regions; this upper bound selects the three heaviest immutable bases, without claiming they are simultaneously the actual closest cells.
Worst ring bound retains all eight far parents,32largest actual L1 tiles and40largest actual L0 tiles. Conservative count bound, not one camera sample.
Only currently admitted data neighbours refine; opaque Pine/Nalati/etc remain real far proxies. This does not claim future M3 native neighbours fit.
